text: Thursday Nights (Shab e Juma) Duas.org       Thursday Nights Rites (Shab e Juma) Signifance of Thursday Nights Signifance of Thursday Nights × Throughout the night Allah (s.w.t.) calls: [ Oddatol Daee , Hadees 67] -Isnât there any believing servant who calls upon Me until before dawn so that I will grant his worldly and spiritual request? -Isnât there any believing servant who repents his sins before down so that I will forgive him? -Isnât there any believing servant whose sustenance is meager and asks Me to increase it before dawn so that I will increase his sustenance? -Isnât there any ailing and believing servant who asks Me to heal him before dawn so that I will heal him? -Isnât there any oppressed believing servant who asks Me to take his right from the oppressor before dawn so that I will help him and restore his right? .â" Certain Days & Times have been preferred for Prayers .
